tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Laying drinking water pipeline in Vivekananda Nagar Ward No 1

itemList.description: Earth work excavation for pipelines/cables by Manual means upto 600 mm trench width, as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, removal of stumps and other deleterious matter, including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or leveling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth for reuse in a radius of 50 m. Filling available excavated earth (excluding rock) in trenches, plinth, sides of foundations etc. in layers not exceeding 20cm in depth, consolidating each deposited layer by ramming and watering and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools, usage& other appurtenances required to complete the work.  In all kinds of soils. Depth upto 1.50m (PWD SR 2023-24 / VOLUME 1 / I NO 1.6.1 / P. NO 06)

Providing and installing at site of work P.V.C. pipes including cost of pipes and specials and labour, including lowering into trenches, laying true to line, level and perfect linking at joints leak proof including jointing of approved type with all labour charges and all lift charges, handling charges including encasing the pipe around to a depth not less than 15 cms with gravel or selected earth available from the excavation etc. complete. 6 Kg/m2: 63mm(weight of pipe -0.662 kg)    (PWD Common  Schedule of Rate 2023-24  Page No. 120  Item No10.14.8   Vol -5)

Refilling available earth around trenches/pipelines, cables in layers not exceeding 20 cms in depth, compacting each deposited layer by ramming after watering with a lead upto 50 m, and lift upto 1.5 m. Including cost of all labour complete as per specifications(PWD Common  Schedule of Rate 2023-24  Page No. 7  Item No 1.10 Vol -1)

Supply of PPR Ball Valve Plastic (Heavy Body) confirming to IS 15801- 2008 and DIN Standards 8077/8092 PPR Ball Valve Plastic (Heavy Body) 63mm (PWD Common  Schedule of Rate 2023-24  Page No. 38  Item No2.72.6  Vol -5)

Supply and delivery at site special moulded variety PVC tee as per IS 7834/ 1987 and fabricated as per IG124/ 1984 with ISI mark with its latest amendmentss63 mm dia PVC Tee (PWD Common  Schedule of Rate 2023-24  Page No. 117  Item No 10.10.5  Vol -5)

Supply and delivery at site special moulded variety PVC elbows as per  IS 7834/ 1987 and fabricated as per IG124/ 1984 with ISI mark with its latest amendments  63 mm dia PVC Elbows (PWD Common  Schedule of Rate 2023-24  Page No. 117  Item No 10.9.5   Vol -5)
